about: Cherkasy: a city of water and pines

Cherkasy stretches along the Dnipro and the Kremenchuk Reservoir, with Sosnivka and pine forests next to it. The city is mostly Soviet-era blocks and new residential complexes, while the outskirts and the shore have private houses and dachas.
So requests here come in pairs: update a city apartment and fit out a house by the water for weekends or year-round living. If it is more convenient, we run both under one contract.

For houses by the water — panoramic windows, terraces and natural materials that tolerate moisture; for apartments — light finishes, built-in wardrobes and well-planned lighting. The design can be combined with [furnishing](/en/turnkey-furnishing) from $250 per m². Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate resale and new-build apartments, as well as houses and dachas. Near Cherkasy we build timber-frame, log and aerated-block houses for holidays or permanent living; on plots by the water we pay special attention to the foundation and drainage.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
